description: This file defines the OAuthClientDao class, which manages data access operations for OAuthClient entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, counting, and deleting OAuthClient records, and encapsulates database query logic specific to OAuth clients.

classes.name: OAuthClientDao
classes.description: A data access object for managing OAuthClient entities, providing methods to save, retrieve, count, and delete OAuth clients within the system.

methods.name: saveOAuthClient
methods.description: Persists an OAuthClient entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getOAuthClientList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of OAuthClient entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getOAuthClientCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of OAuthClient entities matching the search filter parameters.

methods.name: getOAuthClientById
methods.description: Fetches an OAuthClient entity by its unique identifier.

methods.name: getOAuthClientByClientId
methods.description: Finds an OAuthClient entity by its client ID.

methods.name: deleteOAuthClients
methods.description: Deletes OAuthClient entities based on a list of IDs.

methods.name: getOAuthClientQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Creates and configures a QueryBuilderWrapper for retrieving OAuthClient entities based on filter parameters.
